The OpenAGI architecture

Intelligence.
With a little
structure.

A model provides reasoning and language. OpenAGI adds the memory, decisions, schedules, and tool connections that make a personal agent useful over time.

The path through the runtime

Context in.
A considered next move.

Read the runtime ↗
  1. 01 · Signals

    What changed?

    A conversation, a scheduled prompt, a connected tool, or activity you opt to share.

  2. 02 · Scrutiny

    What deserves action?

    Evaluate the evidence, uncertainty, urgency, and risk before choosing a route.

  3. 03 · Agent + memory

    What do we know?

    Bring relevant memory to the model, with the tools allowed for this task.

  4. 04 · A next move

    What should happen?

    Reply, use an authorized tool, ask you, watch for more evidence, or specialize.

Architecture overview. A signal does not automatically authorize an external action.

The core design choices

Three parts.
Built to work together.

01

Directional Adaptive Scrutiny

A decision before an action.

The runtime evaluates the signal against evidence, context, and memory. It chooses act, ask, watch, ignore, or propagate. Thresholds and policies give the system a way to defer or ask when the evidence does not justify proceeding.

Explore Scrutiny ↗
actaskwatchignorepropagate

One signal.
A choice of responses.

02

Tiered memory

Context at the right fidelity.

Short-term memory holds working context. Medium-term memory carries patterns across days. Long-term “Lava” holds durable knowledge. Decay and condensation manage what persists; saved corrections and explicitly retained facts have their own protection.

Explore memory ↗
Working context
Repeated patterns
Durable knowledge

Short → Medium → Long

03

Propagation

Give a specialist a bounded job.

Repeated work or a task needing dedicated attention can create a specialist. Scope, tool selection, and limits on depth and breadth constrain the work. Existing specialists can be reused rather than recreated for the same job.

Inspectable source.

Model layerOpenAI / Anthropic providers · configured compatible endpointsChoose models and credentials for your installation.

Where the boundaries live

Choose the context.
Choose the authority.

Your host stores the agent’s state. The services you connect determine where requests and selected context go.

  • Models. Cloud inference receives selected prompts and tool results. A supported local endpoint changes that data path.
  • Tools. Accounts, credentials, and scopes belong to your setup. Approval rules still apply to external writes.
  • Observation. Screen capture is optional. Native capture and computer control vary by platform and permissions.
  • Devices. Pairing, reachable hosts, and scoped access are device-specific. A Bluetooth radio does not establish an OpenAGI integration.
